description: This file defines the 'Task' controller class within the Opencart admin startup namespace. It handles registering a shutdown function to start background tasks when the PHP script terminates, checking for running tasks, and initiating task processing via command line.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Controller class that manages task scheduling and startup procedures in the admin section.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Registers a shutdown function to start tasks if not running in CLI mode.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Checks if tasks are already processing; if not, initiates task processing via command line depending on OS.
